import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD_A = 998244353;
    static final int MOD_B = 1000000007;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[10];
    static long n, count1, count2, answer;
    static long[] sumArr = new long[10];
    static long[] power = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static boolean check(long x) {
        long limit = 1000000L;
        return x * limit + 999999L <= n && x * limit * 10 > n;
    }

    static void generate_vals(int depth, long prefix) {
        if (depth == 7) return;
        long valToAdd = (count1 - prefix + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        val[depth].add(valToAdd);
        sumArr[depth] += valToAdd;
        count1++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generate_vals(depth + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void process(int depth, long current) {
        if (current > n) return;
        if (check(current)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long temp = ((count2 + 1 - (current * power[i]) % MOD_A) + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
                int position = lowerBound(val[i], MOD_A - temp);
                long size = val[i].size();
                long sumVal = sumArr[i];
                long contribution = (sumVal + temp * size - MOD_A * (size - position)) % MOD_B;
                answer = (answer + contribution) % MOD_B;
            }
            count2 += count1;
        } else {
            count2++;
            long delta = ((count2 - current) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
            answer = (answer + delta) % MOD_B;
            for (int d = (! (depth != 0) ? 0 : 0); d <= 9; d++) {
                process(depth + 1, current * 10 + d);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        generate_vals(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
        }
        count2 = -1;
        answer = 0;
        process(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
